note: Switch "greatWorks" (bet B4 of docs/council/2026-11-23-two-day-plan.md). Great works are objects built over seasons: each season of work takes silver, food and men, and some anger Carthage. The works and what they did are history (docs/research/great-works.md); every number, cost and rule here is invention. The rules are in src/core/works.ts.

labour.name: The peasants of the countryside
labour.summary: Free, but the men on the works are not in the fields: in summer the harvest comes in short.

labour.name: Hired labourers
labour.summary: Paid by the day: the harvest is untouched.

labour.name: Craftsmen of your own cities
labour.summary: Commandeered from the cities under you: cheap, but your allies resent it.

labour.name: Craftsmen from Italy and Greece, at high wages
labour.summary: Dear, and no one at home is hurt by it.

labour.name: Craftsmen from Carthage's own lands as well
labour.summary: Dear, but the best: the work goes a season faster, and Carthage notices every man who leaves.

works.name: The Epipolae wall
works.summary: A wall along the heights of Epipolae, so the city can never again be cut off from the countryside. Syracuse's walls rise by one.
works.doneText: The wall along Epipolae stands, towers at every turn. The city can no longer be cut off from the land.

works.name: The arms workshops
works.summary: Forges in the porticoes, the temples and the gymnasia: shields, helmets, armour for the guard and new engines of war. When done, your army storms walls with engines and catapults, the guard grows stronger and the city's levies are armed.

done.why: Carthage hears of the forges of Syracuse

yourself.why: you walked among the workmen every day and dined with the best

works.doneText: The workshops fall quiet: the arms are made, and your engineers have built a new engine, the catapult.

works.name: The great fleet
works.summary: Timber from Mount Aetna and Italy, ship-sheds round the Great Harbour, and ships of five banks of oars, the first ever built. When done, the fleet brings grain each autumn, catches Carthage's transports more often (5 or 6 becomes 4 to 6), and Carthage's ships can no longer starve your besieged ports.

done.why: ships of five banks ride in the Great Harbour of Syracuse

yourself.why: half the new ships are crewed by citizens

works.doneText: The new ships slide down from the ship-sheds of the Great Harbour, the quinqueremes among them.

timber.name: From Mount Aetna
timber.summary: Fir and pine from the mountain, if the road there is yours: the fort at Aetna and Catana must not be hostile.

timber.name: From Italy
timber.summary: Leave to cut timber in Italy, with teams, boats and crews to bring it: 1 silver more each season.
